name: pm-track-record
description: Builds a single-page portfolio manager track record from Scalable Capital data: index-equivalent returns, conviction book, scenarios and risk.

scripts.prices: node pipeline/fetch_daily.js data/private && node pipeline/fetch_index_history.js data/private
scripts.build: npm run ledger && npm run history && npm run data && npm run page
scripts.sample: node pipeline/make_sample.js data/sample && node pipeline/ledger.js data/sample && node pipeline/history.js data/sample && node pipeline/build_data.js data/sample && node pipeline/build_page.js data/sample dist/sample.html
scripts.test: node tests/render.js dist/portfolio.html test-output && node tests/live.js ok && node tests/live.js partial && node tests/live.js denied
scripts.test:sample: node tests/render.js dist/sample.html test-output/sample && node tests/live.js ok data/sample test-output/sample/_wrapped.html
